tts._comment: Kore is a clear, neutral voice good for educational content

source.text: Photosynthesis is the process by which plants convert sunlight into energy. It happens in the chloroplasts, tiny organelles inside plant cells.
The plant absorbs carbon dioxide from the air and water from the soil. Using sunlight as fuel, it transforms these into glucose and oxygen.
This process is essential for life on Earth. It produces the oxygen we breathe and forms the base of nearly every food chain.
